question: Is the omega prior better parameterised as a 1-D polhode curve (|L|, polhode_label, polhode_phase) rather than a free 3-vector?
narrative_md: Architectural insight (no compute): direct visual observation of the s048c+ viewer's omega-direction sphere on seed 89 surfaced that omega-hat(t) traces a polhode -- a 1-parameter closed curve fixed by the (a-priori-known) inertia tensor. Proposes reparameterising the omega prior as (|L|, polhode_label, polhode_phase) for dynamics-admissible sampling and polhode-tangent-constrained LM. Numbers (seed 89 |omega| 0.24 dps, 0.5% std/mean) need cohort confirmation (s052/s053). Reads truth seed-89 omega(t) as the observation.
